---
title: "GECO Leaflet Map"
pagetitle: "GECO Leaflet Map — Full-screen raster example"
---

```{r}
#| label: full-screen-map
#| echo: false

library(leaflet)
library(raster)

# Georeference R's built-in Maunga Whau elevation matrix over the Zurich area.
# This creates a compact, reproducible raster example without external data.
surface <- raster(
  nrows = nrow(volcano),
  ncols = ncol(volcano),
  xmn = 8.45,
  xmx = 8.62,
  ymn = 47.30,
  ymx = 47.43,
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)
values(surface) <- as.vector(t(volcano[nrow(volcano):1, ]))

raster_palette <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#f4f1e8", "#c7d9ba", "#75b38c", "#519f77", "#24624f", "#3a3a3a"),
  domain = values(surface),
  na.color = "transparent"
)

leaflet(
  width = "100%",
  height = "100vh",
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = TRUE,
    attributionControl = TRUE,
    minZoom = 10
  )
) |>
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$CartoDB.Positron,
    group = "Basemap",
    options = providerTileOptions(maxZoom = 19)
  ) |>
  addRasterImage(
    surface,
    colors = raster_palette,
    opacity = 0.78,
    project = FALSE,
    group = "Elevation raster"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = raster_palette,
    values = values(surface),
    title = "Elevation value",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    position = "topright",
    baseGroups = "Basemap",
    overlayGroups = "Elevation raster",
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  fitBounds(lng1 = 8.45, lat1 = 47.30, lng2 = 8.62, lat2 = 47.43)
```

<p class="eyebrow">Interactive raster example</p>
<h1>GECO Leaflet Map</h1>
<p class="lede">This map demonstrates how a gridded surface can be rendered directly in Leaflet from R.</p>

<section>
<h2>About the layer</h2>
<p>The coloured cells are a georeferenced version of R’s built-in <code>volcano</code> matrix. Each pixel stores one elevation value; neighbouring colours reveal the shape and gradient of the surface.</p>
</section>

<section>
<h2>Explore</h2>
<ul>
<li>Pan and zoom across the raster.</li>
<li>Toggle the raster in the layer control.</li>
<li>Use the legend to interpret cell values.</li>
</ul>
</section>

<span class="toggle-icon" aria-hidden="true">‹</span>
<span class="toggle-label">Hide information</span>
</button>

<script>
(() => {
  const panel = document.getElementById('info-panel');
  const button = panel?.querySelector('.info-panel__toggle');
  const icon = panel?.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
  const label = panel?.querySelector('.toggle-label');

  if (!panel || !button || !icon || !label) return;

  const setOpen = (open) => {
    panel.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    icon.textContent = open ? '‹' : '›';
    label.textContent = open ? 'Hide information' : 'Show information';
  };

  button.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!panel.classList.contains('is-open')));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
  });
})();
</script>
